summary: Pydantic released version 2.10 featuring significant performance optimizations in JSON schema generation and nested serialization via pydantic-core.
why_it_matters: FastAPI and agentic applications spend substantial CPU cycles validating and serializing LLM structured JSON outputs. Core serializer speedups reduce API latency directly.
practical_impact: Developers using Pydantic v2 schemas for high-throughput endpoints will observe reduced per-request overhead and lower CPU usage during model_dump_json calls.
unknowns: Independent multi-threaded benchmark numbers on Windows ARM architectures not yet published.
